title: Governance
bodyHtml:
Reusing Content from the CFDE Liver Resource

The Liver Resource is a free open access resource developed and maintained by the NIH Common Fund Data Ecosystem. Data used in this resource is liver-related data from NIH Common Fund Projects and public repositories such as NIH Gene Expression Omnibus.

Users can interact with the resource through perusing and downloading query results, data, tools, workflows, and use cases.

In the future, the CFDE Liver Resource will enable interactive use, with limited ability to upload liver-related data, tools, workflows, and use cases.

Reusing Content from the CFDE Liver Resource

Users are permitted to use figures, text, and screenshots from the CFDE Liver Resource in presentations and publications, with proper citation (below).

User Tracking and Privacy Policy

This website is committed to protecting your privacy. We do not collect personally identifiable information such as names, email addresses, or account details. However, we may collect limited, non-identifiable information through the use of cookies and similar technologies, including pages visited, time spent on pages, browser type, device information, and general geographic region (e.g., country or city). This information is aggregated and does not identify individual users. We use cookies to understand how visitors interact with the site, improve site performance and user experience, and analyze general usage patterns. Cookies are small text files stored on your device, and you can control or disable them through your browser settings. By continuing to use this site, you consent to this use. The information collected is used solely to monitor and improve website functionality, understand usage trends, and support the development of new features. We do not sell or share your data with third parties for marketing or use it to identify individual users. We may use third-party analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics or similar services) that collect anonymized usage data and may use their own cookies, governed by their respective privacy policies. We take reasonable measures to protect the information collected, although no method of internet transmission is completely secure. You may disable cookies or use browser tools to limit tracking, though this may affect site functionality. We may update this Privacy Policy periodically, with changes posted on this page.

Resource Distribution and Sharing

To encourage data sharing and reproducibility, the CFDE Liver Resource leverages open-source methods and analysis workflows. We make these freely available for use via a BSD 3-Clause license; the code is supplied as is with no implied warranty or promises of support. Code should not be reused for harm. We maintain GitHub repositories from which interested parties can download the source code.

Disclaimer of Warranty: All information, software, tools, workflows, and code are supplied "as is" without warranty of any kind, expressed or implied, including but not limited to the warranties of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, and non-infringement. In no event shall the authors or copyright holders be liable for any claim, damages, or other liability. The code must not be used for harmful or malicious purposes.

How to Cite the CFDE Liver Resource

Users must appropriately cite and/or acknowledge the CFDE Liver Resource and all the relevant underlying data sources as follows:

The results published here are in whole or in part based on information from [Source study name] supported by [NIH grants] obtained from [Source resource name/URL], and from the Common Fund Data Ecosystem Liver Resource (https://www.cfdeliverresource.org), supported by NIH Office of the Director, Awards OT2OD036435 and OT2OD036440. Year Month Date of access; URL of page cited. Specific identifiers/accession numbers for datasets used (if relevant).
